title: 建築構造計画
subtitle: Structural Planning for Architecture
teachers:
KAWAHARA Hiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Learn basic knowledge about building structures and materials, and develop the ability to show structural plans to plan and design mechanically rational building spaces.
advice:
■Learn the basics of structural planning to be safe from loads and external forces, and to select structural types, shapes, materials, and member arrangements from the mechanical standpoint that are suitable for the intended use of the building. A basic knowledge of materials and structural mechanics is required.
■Course Outline
1. Materials, structural types, loads
2. External forces, structural systems
3. Beam and column planning
4. Foundation structure planning
5. Collapse load
6. Structural designers' ideas and examples of structural planning
7. Review of external forces, introduction of structural analysis tools
8. Earthquake mechanisms and calculation of seismic forces
9. Structural planning for vertical and horizontal forces
10. Deformation and torsional behavior of structures

requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of [AE]Structure of Architecture [AD]Design of Architectural Structures (1st term) and Structural Mechanics for Architecture Ⅰ (2nd term) and Ⅱ (3rd term) is required.

activityGoals.body: Explain the basic characteristics of structural materials and the features of structural systems.
Explain the characteristics of loads, external forces, and building damage caused by natural disaster.
Calculate collapse load and deformation using the virtual work method and analysis tool.
Explain the concepts of seismic design.
Examine the earthquake resistance of small houses and explain the reinforcement.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1. Explain, with concrete examples, how architectural structures.
2. Understand the roles of materials and structural components, and explain the process of building a mechanically rational structural system.
3. Present safe and rational structural plans for existing wooden houses.
achievementLevels.standard:
1. Explain the mechanism of architectural structures.
2. Mechanically explain the role of structural components.
3. Present safe structural plans for existing wooden houses.
